description: Read-only, local. The plan for a multi-step or unfamiliar DeXe request — 'create a DAO', 'launch a token with distribution/OTC/staking', 'open a sale', 'pass this proposal': the ordered steps (which tools, in what order, with what params), the questions to ask the user with per-parameter risk notes, and the known pitfalls for that journey. Reference topics answer data questions the same way (flow:"read_dao_data" covers the whole read surface). No args or a free-text `intent` returns the menu; `flow` returns the full plan.

chainId.description: Target chain (56 mainnet / 97 testnet). Defaults to the last-used, then the configured default chain.

flow.description: Exact flow or topic id. Takes precedence over `intent`; omit both for the menu.

intent.description: The user's request in free text — matched against the flow triggers (e.g. 'create a token and sell 20% via OTC').
